stories.title: Flintshire council committee votes to reverse new call-in limits
stories.summary: A Flintshire committee has voted to recommend scrapping new limits on councillors’ power to challenge decisions, ten days after full council approved them. The Constitution and Democratic Services Committee backed the move on Thursday, 5 November, on the casting vote of its chair, Cllr David Coggins Cogan, after members split evenly. stories.title: Shops in Wales face fines of up to £2,500 for selling energy drinks to under-16s
stories.summary: Shops across Wales could be fined up to £2,500 for selling high-caffeine energy drinks to under-16s, under plans published by the Welsh Government. stories.title: Flintshire council rents could rise above inflation from April
stories.summary: Council rents in Flintshire could rise by 4% on average from April, with tenants who get no help from housing benefit paying an average of £5.13 a week more. stories.title: Welsh Government to press for Sir Galahad files to be published
stories.summary: The Welsh Government will write to the UK Government asking for sealed records on the 1982 bombing of the Sir Galahad to be made public, the Senedd has heard. stories.title: Specsavers given green light to expand Mold High Street store
stories.summary: Specsavers has been given permission to expand its Mold High Street store into the shop next door. Flintshire County Council approved plans on 30 October to join 7 High Street with the neighbouring unit at 3-5 High Street, creating one larger store.
